items.q: Q1. Can I pursue electrical engineering in Sweden after Class 12?
items.a: Yes. Indian students with Indian Class 12 qualifications may apply if they meet the general and programme-specific admission requirements, including the required mathematics and science subjects.

items.q: Q2. Are bachelor programs in Electrical Engineering in Sweden offered in English?
items.a: Many of the electrical engineering undergraduate programs are taught in Swedish. For instance, the bachelor’s program at Uppsala University and the undergraduate Electrical Engineering program at KTH require Swedish proficiency. Always check the language of instruction for the intake you have chosen.

items.q: Q3. How long does it take to get a bachelor’s in electrical engineering in Sweden?
items.a: Most bachelor’s engineering programs are three years long and worth 180 ECTS credits. Some engineering qualifications have different structures so please check the official course description.

items.q: Q4. What is the cost of electrical engineering in Sweden?
items.a: Tuition fees vary from one university to another. The tuition fee for the bachelor's program in Electrical Engineering at Uppsala University is SEK 450,000 for the specified intake. Additional living expenses apply. Fees may differ for future intakes.

items.q: Q5. Which jobs in Sweden are available for Electrical Engineers?
items.a: Graduates can find employment in the fields of electrical design, power systems, electronics, automation, telecommunications, embedded systems and renewable energy.
